title: A packed package whose compiled schema holds the canonical text of integral numbers beyond 2^53-1 opens
notes: Its package.metais is written by internal/vectorgen (go test ./internal/vectorgen -run TestPackages -args -update), whose test reproduces the committed bytes. It is packed from the source directory of man/large-integer-source, so its .compiled/schema.json holds 1100000000000000000 and -1100000000000000000.
